summary.intent: Fix review findings on four stacked measurement PRs (#323, #324, #327, #328) in the caliper repo using a background worker agent, while a separate changeset worker continues running.
summary.outcome: All four PRs had findings fixed and pushed with the lint gate passing on each branch; no PRs opened and nothing force-pushed. Caveats remain: #328 needs the new #327 commit merged in, some tests were not verified on a clean checkout, and the changeset worker is still running.

repo: The PRs are stacked: #328's base branch is #327, so when #327 moves, #328 must have the new commit merged in.
Docs for measurement defaults live in docs/measurement.md, and four duplicate copies of the addon-defaults paragraph now point to it.
In the sandbox, 7 core snapshot tests fail only because node_modules is symlinked, which is a known pre-existing failure.
Five oracle test files failed on `typescript` resolution and the CLI watch tests timed out in the worker's setup, so neither was investigated on a clean checkout.
A base build without the `--collapse` flag now fails loudly, so `--lazy` in storybook mode stops working until the old bench is rebuilt with the flag.
The parity doc's data covers antd and shadcn only, not five corpora.

code.finding: Clause 4 is intentionally test-only, and the module docs now say so.

workflow: Worker agents can report completion via task-notification, and each notification may repeat for the same task-id when the agent stops, so duplicates can be ignored.
A new regression test should be confirmed to fail before the fix. The worker did not run its new className test against unfixed code.
Before merging, check that none of the PRs were merged while the worker pushed, because the worker only reported on those that were open when last listed.
